h1Text: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Shillong

items.pText: Shillong gets rain for a large part of the year, and on its hill slopes water runs off fast and damp settles into every shaded corner. That decides most of what goes into a playground here. FunPlay Systems makes outdoor playground equipment for schools, churches, localities and parks in Shillong at our factory in Vasai East, Maharashtra, about 2,060 km away, and sends it by road.

Meghalaya's capital is a hill town with pine-covered slopes, cool summers and cold, dry winters. Many of its schools have a long tradition and limited flat ground. Send us the size of your space, a few photos that show the slope and the age group of the children. We will suggest equipment, mark the safe play area on a layout drawing and tell you what levelling the site needs.

richText.heading: Rain, slopes and moss on a Shillong site

c: On a sloping site, cut a level platform for the play area and give it a drain on the uphill side, so runoff goes round the equipment and not through it. Grout the posts into concrete footings that sit on firm ground, not on loose fill.

In shaded, damp spots, moss and algae can grow on plastic decks and steps and make them slippery. Scrub them with water and a stiff brush every few weeks, especially during the monsoon. Galvanised steel and roto-moulded plastic do not rot, which matters in this climate. For the region, see our

items.q: Can you install playground equipment on hilly ground in Shillong?
items.a: Yes, once a level platform is ready. Our layout drawing shows the size you need. The posts are then grouted into concrete footings on firm ground.

items.q: How do we stop plastic parts from getting slippery in the rain?
items.a: Keep the play area well drained and scrub decks, steps and slides with water and a stiff brush every few weeks during the wet months to remove moss and algae.

items.q: Do you deliver as far as Meghalaya?
items.a: Yes. We deliver by road anywhere in India. Installation in Shillong is done by our own team or a dealer who works with us in the Northeast.
